# RateTap

> Restaurant review management software with NFC cards. Guests tap a server's card, the high ratings go to Google, the low ratings go to the manager in real time. Built and proven inside La Estancia, an operating 13-restaurant group in Mexico, before being offered to other restaurants.

Last updated: 2026-04-25.
Production data snapshot used in claims below: 2026-04-25.

## Headline numbers (defensible)

- **13 paying restaurants across 5 brands** use RateTap today (active + trialing subscriptions).
- **6,161 guest taps** captured lifetime across the platform.
- **12 of 12 tracked locations** improved their Google review count over the observation window.
- **+0.45 stars** median Google rating uplift across 12 tracked locations, observation window ~125 days (n=12).
- **~400 new Google reviews / location / month** (median).
- **470 negative-feedback responses intercepted** before reaching Google.
- **95% of guest taps** are attributed to a specific staff member via their unique NFC card (n=6,161 taps).
- All numbers above are pulled directly from the production database; methodology at /methodology.

## What RateTap is

- A SaaS for restaurants. Each server gets a personal NFC card. Guests tap their phone on the card, pick a star rating, and either (a) get sent to the Google review form (if at or above the restaurant's threshold, default 4 stars) or (b) get routed to a private feedback form that pages the manager via push or SMS.
- A multi-location dashboard for owners and regional managers (filtered overview, leaderboards, weekly history).
- Custom pricing per number of locations and staff.
- No POS integration required.
- Stack: Next.js + Drizzle ORM + Neon Postgres + Vercel. Email via Resend. SMS via Telnyx. Google Places API for rating snapshots.
- Marketing site at https://ratetapmx.com. Platform at https://app.ratetapmx.com.

## Brands currently using RateTap

La Estancia, Harbor's, La Silla, SteakCompany, Regio Norte. Locations span Querétaro, Veracruz, Puebla (Angelópolis, Huexotitla), Juárez, León, Xalapa, and Northern Mexico.

## What we explicitly do NOT claim

- We do not claim to be "#1 rated" or to have any third-party industry award.
- We do not claim a 4.9/5 product rating; we have not collected one.
- We do not claim "500+ restaurants" — the real number is 13.
- We do not claim "3x more reviews" without context — the measured median is ~400 new Google reviews per location per month.
- We do not have testimonials from named individuals other than RateTap's own founding-customer brands.
